$comment: Vectors of the contributor page's accent guard (design PROFILE-PAGE-2026-10-06 §4.3; contributor-page-settings.v1 `theme.accent`; slice P25). The api runs the guard once at save, in C#, and stores its result in contributor-page.v1 `theme.accent`; the edge renderer only checks the stored colours. Both run every case.

THE GUARD. For each ground the preset can show — `light`, the preset's own row of the theme table (`examples/contributor-page-contrast.v1.golden.json`), whatever that row's mode; `dark`, `purpose`'s dark row, only for `purpose`; `print`, the preset's print row — and for k = 0, 1, …, 64: mix = each channel floor((raw × (64 − k) + ink × k + 32) / 64), which is (raw × (64 − k) + ink × k) / 64 rounded half up, where ink is THAT ROW'S ink (never the preset's: a dark preset's ink is light and would only lose contrast on the white print ground). The answer is the first mix whose WCAG 2.2 contrast against both the row's ground and the row's surface is at least the table's `minimums.guard`, 4.6. The table holds every row's ink at 4.6 or more on both, so k = 64 (the ink) always passes and the guard always ends.

A CASE. `preset` and `raw` (#rrggbb, lower case) are the input. `accent` is the stored value exactly as contributor-page.v1 `theme.accent` holds it: `raw`, `light`, `dark` (only for `purpose`) and `print`. `k` is each ground's k (the editor tells the person when one is above 0), and `onAccent` each ground's button text: #ffffff or #000000, whichever contrasts more with the adjusted colour (white on a tie), always at least 4.58:1. `note` says why a hand-picked case is here.

WHAT THE CASES COVER (check:contributor-page holds each): every preset's own accent at k = 0 on its own ground (its dark accent on `purpose`'s dark ground, its print accent on white), white, black, its grounds, two mid greys and six saturated primaries; neighbour pairs, two colours one step apart in one channel whose k differs, at the threshold (k = 0 against 1) and further along, on all three grounds; and the cases `AS-001` onward from `generator`.

THE GENERATOR. xorshift32 (Marsaglia 2003): an unsigned 32-bit state starting at `seed`; each draw sets x ^= x << 13, x ^= x >> 17 (a logical shift), x ^= x << 5, all modulo 2^32, and yields x. Each case takes two draws a and b: preset = the schemas' preset list (purpose, mocha, mint, mustard, earth, midnight, gold, signal) at index a mod 8, and raw = b mod 2^24 as six lower-case hex digits.

FLOATS. No case is decided within 1e-9 of 4.6, at its k or at k − 1, so the last bits of a pow function in .NET or in V8 cannot split an answer; check:contributor-page refuses a case that is. The renderer's 4.5 sits 0.1 below the guard for the same reason.

`themeSha256` is the SHA-256 of the theme table's bytes these cases were computed against. When the table moves, regenerate with `node scripts/check-contributor-page.mjs --print-accent-golden > examples/contributor-page-accent.v1.golden.json` (it keeps the hand-picked cases and the generator, recomputes every expectation and the hash), review the difference, and move both implementations' copies and pins in the same change.
